buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 50 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 50% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Generic Bidders are advised to check applicable GST on their own before quoting. Buyer will not take any responsibility in this regards. GST reimbursement will be as per actuals or as per applicable rates (whichever is lower), subject to the maximum of quoted GST %. 3. Generic Bidder shall submit the following documents along with their bid for Vendor Code Creation: a. Copy of PAN Card. b. Copy of GSTIN. c. Copy of Cancelled Cheque. d. Copy of EFT Mandate duly certified by Bank. 4. Inspection

Nominated Inspection Agency: On behalf of the Buyer organization, any one of the following Inspection Agency would be conducting inspection of stores before acceptance: Pre-dispatch Inspection at Seller Premises (applicable only if pre-dispatch inspection clause has been selected in ATC): NOT APPLICABLE Post Receipt Inspection at consignee site before acceptance of stores: BY AUTHORIZED REPRESENTATIVE(S) OF CGM/SAF 5. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 6. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Additional Terms & Condition (ATC) 1. Refer T & C [Terms & conditions of Open Tender Enquiry] 2. This tender enquiry is issued without any commitment at this stage. 3. This tender enquiry is governed with AWEIL PM-2022. 4. IP Address: If two or more firms are found to have submitted their bids through same IP Address, all th e offers will be summarily rejected without any further correspondence with the firms. 5. L.D. Clause: If, firm found to fail the delivery of components period wise as mentioned, the quantity of that period will be deleted/staggered LD period wise will be levied.LD will be applicable @ 0.5% per week ( or part thereof) to 10% maximum of the value of the delayed supplies. 6. Firm should read, understand, and accept the special conditions pertaining to GST Tax Indemnity clause attached in this TE. 8. Firm has to sign & submit Non-disclosure agreement(NDA) with buyer which is attached in this TE. 9. Firm(s)/vendor(s) has to be an "Indian Enterprises" & conformance for the same has to be submitted by participant firms. 9. Copy of drawing: Being Intellectual Property/TOT drawing documents are included in this TE, hence co py of drawing(s) is not attached. Interested bidder(s) can obtain the drawing documents after signing of No n-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) Annexure-B with Buyer. 10. Minor Modification in Drawing: Minor modification(s) may be carried out in drawing, accordingly ex isting drawing may be updated. The updated drawing shall be issued at the time of placement of supply or der and DDO section shall certify whether the modification in drawing is major or minor in nature. The firm shall supply the store as per updated/latest drawing provided at the time of supply order. 11. Inspection criteria: a. Firm is to comply all condition of Acceptance Test Procedure (ATP) issued with Supply order and submit all test certificates, Inspection reports, dimension reports as per Drawing, Quality Acceptance Plan (QAP), Specification & ATP for all the materials and processes mentioned therein. Firm to provide test certificates from NABL labs wherever applicable. b. Firm to submit test pieces of raw material along with test reports for chemical, mechanical and other tes t as per specifications mentioned in drawing/QAP/ATP/specifications of components/assembly. Firm to prov ide test certificates from NABL labs wherever applicable. c. Firm is to comply following condition w.r.t. blowhole/porosity allowed in GUIDE-MIM (Annexure attached) & have to quote for supply of the item accordingly:- (i) Porosity of size 4.00 mm are allowed at two specified locations (A & B)

(ii) No more than 1 pore is allowed in each specified location (iii) The distance of the porosity from the outer wall of the part should not be less than 2.00 mm (iv) It is to be noted that these allowances are subject to specified locations (A & B) 12. Pre-qualification Criteria: a. Firm(s)/ vendor(s) should be capable to manufacture & supply tendered item(s) as specified in drawing, specification, accordingly vendors shall be required to get themselves registered for the tendered item(s) at SAF. Vendor(s)/firm(s) shall be required to submit their registration request if not registered for tendere d store. The capacity of the firm shall be assessed for the vendor who has submitted their registration req uest at SAF for tendered store through VRRF. b. Firm(s)/vendor(s) are to ensure that duly completed VRRF along with requisite assessment fee (as applic able) should be submitted on or before date of opening of tender either through email or physically. Failin g to furnish as stated above, offer(s) is/are liable to be rejected without any further correspondence. c. Interested bidder(s) can obtain the drawing documents after signing of Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) "Annexure-B" with Buyer before TOD. Firm(s)/vendor(s) who have not collected the drawings before TOD, t heir offer shall be liable to be ignored considering futile bidding. Vendors/firm(s) is required to send reques t for providing drawing along with signed 'Annexure-B' NDA (with mentioned valid email, mobile number a nd aadhar number of person signing the NDA for drawing sharing/Password) at least 03 days before tender /bid opening (TOD) to process the request. Drawing request will not be entertained for the same, received after said period. If three days before TOD falls on Sunday/Factory Holiday then the next working day will be considered as last day for obtaining of drawing. d. Bidder has to provide the written declaration that material (i.e. GOST/approved alternate material) give n in the drawing has been understood by the bidder and bidder can outsource the requisite raw material fo r uninterrupted supply to SAF. Bidder should also give a written declaration that Drawings of component h ave been completely studied and understood by the bidder and bidder will ensure uninterrupted supply m eeting all the drawing dimensions and specifications mentioned in the drawing. e. The firm should have never been black-listed from any Govt. Agency, self declaration by the firm to be p rovided along with bid submission. f. Firm(s)/Vendor(s) should have following essential/core facilities (available in-house only) required for manufacturing as well as inspection/testing technologies for the tendered item as follows- >>>>> MIM facilities >>>>> Dimensional Inspection (Metrology) facility >>>>> MPI testing facility Firm(s)/Vendor(s) should have following desirable facilities(available in-house or outsourced * thro ugh Tie-up/MoU) required for manufacturing as well as inspection/testing technologies for the tendered i tem as follows- >>>>> Heat Treatment >>>>> Chemical, Mechanical, Izod testing from NABL lab >>>>> Rockwell Hardness inspection from NABL lab otherwise testing machine to be calibrated from NA BL lab >>>>> Surface Roughness Testing facility from NABL lab otherwise testing machine to be calibrated from NABL lab >>>>> Decarburization & Sintered Density Testing facility >>>>> Radiography Testing from NABL lab *In case of outsourcing of manufacturing/Inspection/testing facilities (Desirable facilities), firm should sub mit valid, authenticated Tie-up/MOU documents signed by both parties and the firm should submit the P & M list of the outsourcing firm. Note/Remarks-

(i) Capacity Verification is required to be done if firm is not registered at any ordnance factory of erstwhile OFB for any item manufactured by MIM technology. (ii) For firms registered for components manufactured by MIM technology at any ordnance factory of erstw hile OFB, firm to submit Registration Certificate of any ordnance factory of erstwhile OFB clearly mentionin g the component manufactured with MIM technology along with VRRF. g. Firm(s)/vendor(s) who are already registered for the item 'GUIDE SAF DRG. NO. SK-203RM-01-1.1 THRO UGH MIM ROUTE, Item code: 7014300044' shall also need to submit fresh VRRF application along with req uisite assessment fee (as applicable) since essential/core and desirable facilities required for manufacturin g, inspection/testing technologies for the tendered item is incorporated in this T.E. . 7.
